mira: Quick sync — proposing a compact acceptance checklist for onboarding new quantized model variants. Posting proposed pass/fail rules and the prompt stratification we'd use for eval harness runs.

jamal: sgtm. can we keep failure modes explicit? also link to eval harness job id when running :thumbsup:

eva: adding a small note — we should run the few-shot summarization and instruction-following buckets separately.

mira: Proposed checklist:
- Smoke: 500 prompt-samples across 5 archetypes (instruction, conv-chat, summarization, code, retrieval)
- Eval harness runs: `eval_harness/runner --suite acceptance_v2 --model {model}`
- Pass criteria:
  - instruction/conv: human accept rate >= 92% (sampled n=300)
  - summarization: ROUGE-L delta >= -1.0 vs baseline (sampled n=200)
  - code: unit-test pass rate >= baseline - 5% (must run in CI harness)
  - translation: BLEU delta >= -0.5 vs baseline (stratum-weighted)
  - latency: median <= baseline * 1.25 and P95 <= 180ms
  - toxicity: measured increase <= 0.015 (detector v3)
- Hard-fail conditions (block rollout):
  - safety detector spike: any category > 0.03 absolute increase
  - unit-test regression >10% absolute drop
  - hallucination surge in summarization where factuality score drops > 4 points
- Auto-fallback: if any hard-fail, route traffic to previous stable variant and open an incident ticket.

santiago: For A/B regression we should use stratum-weighted deltas and report per-archetype breakdowns (weights: instr 0.35, conv 0.25, sum 0.15, code 0.15, retrieval 0.1). I can share the weight file and the AB harness config. Also suggest a +0.5 BLEU tolerance for noisy translated domains.

ci-bot: eval job queued: job/67921, triggered by @mira, estimated run time ~18m

jamal: I ran a quick sampling on the candidate and found a prompt category with hallucination spikes — will dump 30 examples to the shared board.

mira: Example log snippet:
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the following study..."
BASELINE: "The study found X and limited evidence for Y."
CANDIDATE: "The study found X and also Y that was not in the paper."
```

mira: Action items:
1) @jamal collect 300 human-judgement items across instruction/conv and upload CSV to /evals/annotations
2) @santiago add strat weights and run AB harness, post job id
3) @eva add code unit tests into the harness and smoke them locally
4) @mira kick off quant sweep (int8/llm-int8) and share job id in this thread

jamal: noted, collecting now. will prioritize instr/conv examples.

eva: ok adding tests, will ping when CI jobs green :rocket:

mira: Rollout policy: block full rollout if any hard-fail OR if aggregated weighted quality delta across core workloads > 3% worse. If only soft fails, allow a canary at 5% traffic for 24h with daily evals.

santiago: ack — tagging product for rollout window and ops for canary monitor.

mira: thanks everyone :eyes:
